meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein **Banarasi silk, Kanjeevaram-style jacquard, chiffon/georgette sequence, Paithani cotton-silk aur organza sarees** achhe options rahenge. Online prices roughly **₹250–₹1,500** ke beech mil rahe hain; better-finish silk-blend options ₹750–₹1,250 tak milte hain.[1][2]

## Budget ke hisaab se best choices

- **₹300–₹600: Kanjeevaram-style jacquard ya Banarasi-look saree** — shaadi guest ke liye traditional aur affordable; blouse piece included ho to better. Meesho par aise options ₹290–₹639 ke aas-paas listed hain.[2]
- **₹400–₹800: Paithani cotton-silk saree** — bright colours, zari border aur festive look; bridal-family functions ke liye suitable. Paithani cotton-silk options ₹481 ke aas-paas listed hain.[3]
- **₹500–₹1,000: Georgette/chiffon sequence saree** — reception, sangeet ya cocktail function ke liye lightweight aur glamorous.
- **₹750–₹1,250: Silk-blend embroidered saree** — zyada polished look aur comparatively better finishing; Libas par sale options ₹759–₹1,259 ke range mein dikh rahe hain.[4]
- **₹1,000–₹1,500: Organza ya tissue saree** — elegant, modern aur daytime wedding ke liye achhi; pastel pink, lavender, peach ya mint colours choose karein.
- **Bride ke liye:** budget tight ho to red/maroon **Banarasi-look ya art-silk saree** le sakti hain; lekin asli Kanjeevaram/Banarasi silk ke liye ₹2,000 se upar ka budget rakhna behtar hoga.

## Colour suggestions

- **Shaadi:** wine, maroon, rani pink, emerald green, royal blue  
- **Reception:** black, navy, lavender, champagne, silver  
- **Haldi/mehendi:** yellow, mustard, green, orange  
- **Day wedding:** peach, pink, cream, pastel green  

## Online kharidte waqt

- Product reviews mein **customer photos** zaroor dekhein.
- “Silk” ke bajay description mein **silk blend, art silk ya jacquard** likha ho sakta hai—fabric details check karein.
- Blouse piece, saree length, return policy aur delivery date verify karein.
- Bahut sasti saree mein colour ya fabric photo jaisa na hone ka risk hota hai; shaadi ke liye **4-star-plus rating aur review photos** prefer karein.
- Budget-friendly search terms: **“Banarasi silk saree under 1000,” “Kanjeevaram jacquard saree,” “sequence georgette saree with blouse,” “Paithani cotton silk saree.”**
